arxiv-1712-07128.title: Imperfect Thermalizations Allow for Optimal Thermodynamic Processes
arxiv-1712-07128.creator: Elisa Bäumer, Martí Perarnau-Llobet, Philipp Kammerlander, Henrik Wilming, Renato Renner
arxiv-1712-07128.description: Abstract Optimal (reversible) processes in thermodynamics can be modelled as step-by-step processes, where the system is successively thermalized with respect to different Hamiltonians by an external thermal bath. However, in practice interactions between system and thermal bath will take finite time, and precise control of their interaction is usually out of reach.

arxiv-2105-05486.title: TextOCR: Towards large-scale end-to-end reasoning for arbitrary-shaped scene text
arxiv-2105-05486.creator: Amanpreet Singh , Guan Pang ∗ , Mandy Toh ∗ , Jing Huang, Wojciech Galuba, and Tal Hassner
arxiv-2105-05486.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Amanpreet Singh , Guan Pang ∗ , Mandy Toh ∗ , Jing Huang, Wojciech Galuba, and Tal Hassner. A crucial component for the scene text based reasoning required for TextVQA and TextCaps datasets involve detecting and recognizing text present in the images using an optical character recognition (OCR) system.

arxiv-2106-11130.title: Long induced paths in a configuration model
arxiv-2106-11130.creator: Nathanaël Enriquez, Gabriel Faraud, Laurent Ménard, Nathan Noiry
arxiv-2106-11130.description: Abstract In an article published in 1987 in Combinatorica [ 5 ] , Frieze and Jackson established a lower bound on the length of the longest induced path (and cycle) in a sparse random graph. Their bound is obtained through a rough analysis of a greedy algorithm.

arxiv-2110-12804.title: High-Speed Trains Access Connectivity Through RIS-Assisted FSO Communications
arxiv-2110-12804.creator: Pouya Agheli, Hamzeh Beyranvand, and Mohammad Javad Emadi
arxiv-2110-12804.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pouya Agheli, Hamzeh Beyranvand, and Mohammad Javad Emadi. Free-space optic (FSO) is a promising solution to provide broadband Internet access for high-speed trains (HSTs). Besides, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) are considered as hardware technology to improve performance of optical wireless communication systems. In this paper, we propose a RIS-assisted FSO system to provide access connectivity for HTSs, as an upgrade for the existing direct and relay-assisted FSO access setups.

arxiv-2205-12395.title: Model of Charge Transfer Collisions between C 60 C_{60} and Slow Ions
arxiv-2205-12395.creator: J. Smucker, J. A. Montgomery Jr, M. Bredice, M. G. Rozman, R. Côté, H. R. Sadeghpour, D. Vrinceanu, V. Kharchenko
arxiv-2205-12395.description: Abstract A semi-classical model describing the charge transfer collisions of C 60 C_{60} fullerene with different slow ions has been developed to explain available experimental data. This data reveals multiple Breit-Wigner like peaks in the cross sections, with subsequent peaks of reactive cross sections decreasing in magnitude.

arxiv-2210-11613.title: Quantum logic control and precision measurements of molecular ions in a ring trap - a new approach for testing fundamental symmetries
arxiv-2210-11613.creator: Yan Zhou, Joshua O. Island, Matt Grau
arxiv-2210-11613.description: Abstract We present a new platform facilitating quantum logic control of polar molecular ions in a segmented ring ion trap, paving the way for precision measurements. This approach focuses on achieving near-unity state preparation and detection, as well as long spin coherence.

arxiv-2308-12665.title: Note on intrinsic metrics on graphs
arxiv-2308-12665.creator: Daniel Lenz, Marcel Schmidt, Felix Seifert
arxiv-2308-12665.description: Abstract . We study the set of intrinsic metrics on a given graph. This is a convex compact set and it carries a natural order. We investigate existence of largest elements with respect to this order. We show that the only locally finite graphs which admit a largest intrinsic metric are certain finite star graphs.

arxiv-2309-12277.title: On some generalizations of Hadamard’s inversion theorem beyond differentiability
arxiv-2309-12277.creator: A. Uderzo a
arxiv-2309-12277.description: Abstract A recognized trend of research investigates generalizations of the Hadamard’s inversion theorem to functions that may fail to be differentiable. In this vein, the present paper explores some consequences of a recent result about the existence of global Lipschitz continuous inverse by translating its metric assumptions in terms of nonsmooth analysis constructions.

arxiv-2411-13850.title: ALKPU: an active learning method for the DeePMD model with Kalman filter
arxiv-2411-13850.creator: Haibo Li, Xingxing Wu, Liping Liu, Lin-Wang Wang, Long Wang, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia
arxiv-2411-13850.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Haibo Li, Xingxing Wu, Liping Liu, Lin-Wang Wang, Long Wang, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia. Neural network force field models such as DeePMD have enabled highly efficient large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with ab initio accuracy. However, building such models heavily depends on the training data obtained by costly electronic structure calculations, thereby it is crucial to carefully select and label the most representative configurations during model training to improve both extrapolation capability and training efficiency.

arxiv-2411-16541.title: The Hausdorff measure of the boundary of the Brownian disk
arxiv-2411-16541.creator: Alexis Metz-Donnadieu ametzdonnadieu@dma.ens.fr
arxiv-2411-16541.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexis Metz-Donnadieu ametzdonnadieu@dma.ens.fr. Consider the boundary ∂ 𝔻 \partial\mathbb{D} of the Brownian disk 𝔻 \mathbb{D} as a metric space by endowing it with the (restriction of the) metric of 𝔻 \mathbb{D} . We show that the uniform measure on ∂ 𝔻 \partial\mathbb{D} coincides with the Hausdorff measure associated with the gauge function h ⁡ ( s ) = κ ​ s 2 ​ log ⁡ log ⁡ ( 1 / s ) h(s)=\kappa s^{2}\log\log(1/s) for some deterministic constant κ > 0 \kappa>0 .

arxiv-2501-14426.title: CENTS: Generating synthetic electricity consumption time series for rare and unseen scenarios
arxiv-2501-14426.creator: Michael Fuest, Alfredo Cuesta, Kalyan Veeramachaneni
arxiv-2501-14426.description: Abstract Recent breakthroughs in large-scale generative modeling have demonstrated the potential of foundation models in domains such as natural language, computer vision, and protein structure prediction. However, their application in the energy and smart grid sector remains limited due to the scarcity and heterogeneity of high-quality data.

arxiv-2508-00574.title: SynAdapt : Learning Adaptive Reasoning in Large Language Models via Synthetic Continuous Chain-of-Thought
arxiv-2508-00574.creator: Jianwei Wang, Ziming Wu, Fuming Lai, ShaobingLian, Ziqian Zeng
arxiv-2508-00574.description: Abstract While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves model performance, it incurs significant time costs due to the generation of discrete CoT tokens (DCoT). Continuous CoT (CCoT) offers a more efficient alternative, but existing CCoT methods are hampered by indirect fine-tuning, limited alignment, or inconsistent targets. To overcome these limitations, we propose SynAdapt , an innovative efficient reasoning framework.

arxiv-2508-10085.title: A Carroll Limit of AdS/CFT: A Triality with Flat Space Holography?
arxiv-2508-10085.creator: Andrea Fontanella, Oliver Payne
arxiv-2508-10085.description: Abstract We construct a novel holographic duality by taking a Carrollian limit of the AdS/CFT correspondence, relating string theory in a Carroll bulk geometry to a Carroll 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 Super Yang-Mills theory. We further propose the existence of an underlying triality connecting Carroll string theory, relativistic string theory in flat spacetime, and Carroll gauge theory.

arxiv-2604-09246.title: DDSP-QbE++: Improving Speech Quality for DDSP-based Speech Anonymisation for Atypical Speech Volume: 1 1
arxiv-2604-09246.creator: Suhita Ghosh, Yamini Sinha, Sebastian Stober

britannica-1911-thanet-isle-of.title: Thanet, Isle of (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-thanet-isle-of.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-thanet-isle-of.description: Article 'Thanet, Isle of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Kent, England, insulated by the two branches of the river Stour, and forming one of the eight parliamentary divisions of the county. Its name is said to be derived from Saxon tene, a beacon or fire (probably from the number of watch-fires existing on this easily ravaged coast), and numerous remains of Saxon occupation have been found, as at Osengal near Ramsgate.

plos-pone-0349937.title: Toxicity analysis of food contaminants based on network toxicology and molecular docking: A case study of Zearalenone
plos-pone-0349937.creator: Xiaobo Xu, RuiLi Miao, Ping Xu, Leishan Chen, Kun Zhao, PingHui Xu, Hanna Fotina
plos-pone-0349937.description: Toxicity analysis of food contaminants based on network toxicology and molecular docking: A case study of Zearalenone

pmc-12492013.title: Mechanistic insight into the frequency-dependent ultrasound-assisted extraction of Rosa laevigata Polysaccharides: Structure, antioxidant activity, and process optimization
pmc-12492013.creator: Yuyuan Duan, Shuting Wang, Xiaorong Zhang, Huimei Zhang, Huizhu Wang, Shuai Chen
pmc-12492013.description: Rosa laevigata Michx. polysaccharide (RLMP) possess considerable bioactive potential; however, the frequency-dependent mechanisms underlying their ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE) remain insufficiently understood. This study systematically investigated the influence of ultrasonic frequency on the extraction efficiency, structural characteristics, and antioxidant activity of RLMP, with the goal of optimizing the UAE process.

pmc-12589436.title: Shape characteristics and deformation properties of granite crushed stone during compression
pmc-12589436.creator: Chang Liu, Daolu Quan, Qingbiao Wang, Xiaobo Su
pmc-12589436.description: The shape of particles plays a significant role in determining the mechanical properties of granular materials. This study systematically investigated the effects of particle shape on the crushing behaviors of granite crushed stone using a 3D particle measurement system, image processing techniques, and lateral restraint compression tests.

pmc-12608261.title: Effect of Different Sand Types and Fractions on Ballistic Resistance of High-Performance Steel Fibre-Reinforced Concrete
pmc-12608261.creator: Michal Mára, Jindřich Fornůsek, Tomáš Hrabě, Radoslav Sovják, Bin Han
pmc-12608261.description: High-Performance Fibre-Reinforced Concrete (HPFRC) is an advanced composite material known for its exceptional energy absorption and dissipation capabilities. To improve its ballistic resistance, HPFRC samples were prepared using 1.5% steel fibre content and varying levels of silica. Ballistic trials employed standard 7.62 × 39 cartridges, each comprising a full metal casing around a mild steel core.

pmc-13006398.title: Integrative CSF profiling identifies disease-specific immune responses in leptomeningeal disease
pmc-13006398.creator: Paula Nieto, Svenja Klinsing, Ginevra Caratù, Mareike Dettki, Domenica Marchese, Katharina J. Weber, Samuel Morabito, Patricia Lorden, Irene Ruano, Katharina Imkeller, M. Angels Velasco, Silvia Vidal, Juan L. Melero, Philipp Euskirchen, Marcus Czabanka, Karl H. Plate, Patrick N. Harter, Anna Pascual
pmc-13006398.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryLeptomeningeal disease (LMD) is a devastating manifestation of advanced cancer, marked by rapid neurological decline and limited treatment options. Immune profiling in central nervous system (CNS) neoplasms, including LMD, is critical for understanding disease biology and guiding therapy. Here, we use single-cell RNA and T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from patients with CNS lymphoma (CNSL), brain metastases (BrMs), and glioblastoma (GB), alongside deep TCR sequencing of blood and spatial transcriptomics of brain lesions.

pmc-13051871.title: Overcoming Immunotolerance in Chronic Hepatitis B: Efficacy of Granulocyte‐Macrophage Colony‐Stimulating Factor–Based Immunotherapy in Achieving Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Seroclearance
pmc-13051871.creator: Shuang Geng, Feifei Yang, Hongyu Jia, Gan Zhao, Weidong Zhao, Jie Yu, Haoxiang Zhu, Huan Cai, Lishan Yang, Shuren Zhang, Fang Yu, Xiang Jin, Shijie Zhang, Xianzheng Wang, Yida Yang, Jiming Zhang, Bin Wang
pmc-13051871.description: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains incurable due to the immune system's tolerance toward the hepatitis B virus (HBV) surface antigen (HBsAg). This study aimed to achieve a functional cure by breaking HBV tolerance through immunotherapy. CHB patients were treated with either standard nucleotide analog (NA) therapy (Adefovir Dipivoxil, ADV) (Cohort 1) or ADV combined with interferon‐alpha (IFN‐α) (Cohort 2).

pmc-13197368.title: The talking heads attentional bias assessment task: A readily available, reliable, and effective task for assessing attentional bias
pmc-13197368.creator: Mahdi Mazidi, Colin MacLeod, Seyran Ranjbar, Owen Myles, Ben Grafton
pmc-13197368.description: Cognitive theories contend that attentional bias to negative information contributes to elevated trait anxiety. However, research in this area has been hindered by the lack of a standardized assessment task that demonstrates the required qualities, including strong internal consistency and ecological validity.

pmc-13455413.title: Lifestyle behaviors during exam periods and their association with academic performance among Palestinian medical students: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13455413.creator: Wasef Alhroub, Maaweya Jabareen, Ahmad Fasfoos, Omair Bseiso, Joana Deeik, Ahmad Hasan Ahmoud, Amro K. Al-Manasrah, Ibraheem Mohammed Thalji, Ahmad Basil Abu Arish, Iyad Moayad Adawi, Mustafa Murad Alqawasmeh, Monther M. Hroub, Musbah Hroub, Jamal Ahmad
pmc-13455413.description: BackgroundMedical students often face significant psychological and lifestyle challenges during examination periods, including sleep disruption, increased caffeine intake, altered dietary habits, low physical activity, and higher tobacco use. These behaviors may influence academic performance, yet evidence remains inconsistent.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted from April to October 2025 among 403 medical students from five universities in Palestine.

uslaw-usc-t28-s1366.title: 28 U.S.C. § 1366 — Construction of references to laws of the United States or Acts of Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s1366.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s1366.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part IV (Jurisdiction And Venue); Chapter 85 (District Courts; Jurisdiction). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this chapter, references to laws of the United States or Acts of Congress do not include laws applicable exclusively to the District of Columbia.
